changeSet.author: evt-l3
changeSet.comment: DETECTED is removed (decision D.2): an incident is born REPORTED, detections are delivery alerts. The rows still DETECTED (opened by the removed detection listeners) become REPORTED. Idempotent.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE tnt_incidents SET status = 'REPORTED' WHERE status = 'DETECTED';

changeSet.author: evt-l3
changeSet.comment: blocking (QO-2) and its courier forcing; delivery_outcome (RESUMED / FAILED / DISPUTE, mandatory on every move to RESOLVED) and responsible_party (payer of a return, B.6); resolution_note and resolution_proposed_at (PENDING_CONFIRMATION, QO-14: automatic confirmation after the delay); event_sequence = aggregateVersion of the last event published on tnt.incident.events. Existing open incidents were all treated as blocking (old isBlockingMission = not terminal and not DETECTED): they keep blocking = TRUE. Additive and idempotent.

changeSet.author: evt-l3
changeSet.comment: Automatic confirmation job (QO-14): incidents waiting for the courier's confirmation.
